LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Settings.Intro: Reorganise the Architect menu from inside the game.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Settings.ShowArchitectBu: Adds a row at the bottom of the Architect window to open the editor without a keyboard. Reopen the Architect menu for the change to take effect.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Settings.KeyHint: Keyboard shortcut: {0} — change it in Options → Keyboard configuration.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.Title: Dropdown groups
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.Intro: Collapse several buildings under a single Architect menu button. Changes apply immediately. Drag a member to reorder it.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.IconSourceTip: "Placed building" is the safe choice. With "Build material" and the grid menu, a building whose cost cannot be determined vanishes from the menu.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.NoSelection: Select a group on the left, or create one.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.ConfirmDelete: Delete the group "{0}"? Its buildings will revert to their original group.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.OverrideCount: {0} building(s) moved from their original settings.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.ConfirmReset: Erase every group you created and every building move?
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.ConfirmDissolv: Delete "{0}"? This group belongs to another mod: its def will be recreated on next startup, but it will no longer appear in this list.
Delete "{0}"? Its {1} buildings will become separate buttons again in the Architect menu, and the group will disappear from this list.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.SplitWarning: Group split across {0} categories: the game will make that many separate buttons.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.SplitWarningTi: Categories involved: {0}. A dropdown group is not tied to any category: the game groups category by category.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Dropdowns.GroupCategoryT: Forces a category on the whole group: its members are moved there, and any you add later will follow. Without it, the group appears wherever its members are, and splits into several buttons if they are scattered.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Settings.KeyHintUnbound: No default keyboard shortcut — assign one in Options → Keyboard configuration.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Categories.Title: Categories
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Categories.Intro: The arrows move a category among its siblings. Click its name to change label, colour and icon.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Categories.ConfirmResetO: Put every category back in its original order?
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.EditCategory.Title: Appearance: {0}
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.EditCategory.Label: Label
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.EditCategory.NoArchitect: Architect Icons is not loaded: icon selection is unavailable.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.EditCategory.ConfirmDele: Delete the category "{0}"? Its buildings will return to their original category.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Categories.NoNesting: Without Better Architect Menu there are no subcategories: the category is created at top level.
LanguageData.ArchitectStudio.Settings.ConfirmResetEve: Erase every Architect Studio setting: groups, created categories, orders, labels, colours and icons?
